summary.text: Theresa Mah is a Democratic Illinois state representative who has served in the House since 2017, currently representing District 24, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She holds a Ph.D. in history and previously worked as a senior policy advisor to former Governor Pat Quinn.

paragraphs.text: Theresa Mah earned a B.A. in history from the University of California, Berkeley, in 1991 and a Ph.D. in U.S. social and cultural history, race and ethnicity, and Asian American history from the University of Chicago in 1999.

Her career experience includes working as a senior policy advisor to former Governor Pat Quinn, a community development and policy consultant with the Coalition for a Better Chinese American Community, and an adjunct professor in Asian American studies at the University of Illinois at Chicago.
She served on the Illinois Advisory Council on Bilingual Education and the board of directors of Common Cause Illinois.
Mah's tenure in the Illinois House began in 2017; Ballotpedia lists her as winning general elections for District 2 in 2016, 2018 and 2020 and for District 24 in 2022 and 2024.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.
